page.title: Scan barcode
page.subtitle: Package nutrition from Open Food Facts.

camera.preview: Camera preview for reading a barcode
camera.aim: Point the camera at the barcode on the package
camera.privacyWeb: Images are processed in your browser and never sent.
camera.privacyNative: JoyoRogo needs camera access to read package barcodes. Barcodes are read on your device; the photo is never sent anywhere.
camera.unsupported: Camera isn't available in this browser.
camera.unsupportedDetail: This browser can't read barcodes with the camera yet (Chrome on Android can). Type the number printed under the barcode, or use the JoyoRogo app on your phone.

error.denied: Camera access was denied. Allow it in your browser settings, or type the number.
error.failed: Couldn't open the camera. Type the barcode number below.

entry.invalid: That barcode number isn't valid. Check the digits (8, 12 or 13).

lookup.searching: Looking up {{code}} on Open Food Facts…

notFound.title: Not on Open Food Facts yet
notFound.body: Barcode {{code}} isn't listed, so there are no nutrition numbers. Photograph the product or enter the calories yourself.

incomplete.body: {{reason}} This product isn't logged automatically. Photograph it or enter the calories from the label.

reason.no_kcal: Open Food Facts has no calorie data for this product.
reason.implausible: The nutrition numbers on Open Food Facts look off, so we don't use them.

fallback.photoNote: The AI estimates from the photo; it doesn't read the label numbers. If you have the label numbers, enter them yourself.

result.missing: Open Food Facts has no {{fields}} data for this product; missing values are logged as unknown, not zero.
result.source: Source: Open Food Facts, a community database. Numbers may differ from your package label; double-check if unsure.

errors.invalidCode: That barcode isn't valid. Check the digits (8, 12 or 13).
errors.offUnavailable: Can't reach Open Food Facts right now. Try again shortly or enter it by hand.
